# BFLabs Agent Readiness

BFLabs Agent Readiness checks whether a public website is discoverable, understandable, and actionable for agents. It keeps readiness separate from AI visibility and business outcome.

## Use it

- [Free diagnostic](https://readiness.bflabs.cn/)
- [Opt-in public leaderboard](https://readiness.bflabs.cn/leaderboard)
- [Methodology](https://readiness.bflabs.cn/methodology)
- [OpenAPI](https://readiness.bflabs.cn/openapi.json)
- [Agent Skills index](https://readiness.bflabs.cn/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json)
- [Root Skill](https://readiness.bflabs.cn/skills/bflabs-agent-readiness)
- [MCP server card](https://readiness.bflabs.cn/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json)
- [BF Labs SkillHub](https://skills.bflabs.cn/catalog.html#geo)

## Agent workflow

1. Run a public scan through the website, API, CLI, or MCP.
2. Read the three readiness axes and the deterministic Agent Journey separately.
3. Use the single selected child Skill in the generated prompt.
4. Change only evidence-backed items and run tests.
5. After the site owner deploys, run a fresh public scan.

Public leaderboard inclusion is optional and off by default. The readiness scan does not measure AI-platform visibility, leads, conversion, or revenue.
